name: Ocrwell
description: Teaches Claude Code the OCRWell document OCR API so it generates correct integration code without having to be fed documentation. The agent learns the /v1 endpoints, the two-step upload flow (create upload → PUT to presigned URL → create document), asynchronous job polling with backoff, both structured-extraction schema formats (template and JSON Schema), the full error catalogue, rate-limit headers, and HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature verification. It also knows the quiet gotchas, like treating a 200 response carrying job.status: "failed" as a job failure rather than an HTTP success.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `ocrwell` (Use when writing or debugging code that calls the OCRWell document OCR API — extracting plain text or…).

Installs with `claude plugin install ocrwell@claude-community` from `ocrwell/skill`.
